meta.title: Sunaray Gaon · Village Data
meta.summary: A living count of who lives here, how people work, who is studying, and where infrastructure still needs work.

privacy.policy: Public page shows rates and government delivery only. Person names stay with the Samaj / logged-in members.

demands_of_state.title: Publish Jal Jeevan FHTC list for this ward
demands_of_state.why: Tank exists; 0% working taps. Name the contractor, source, and completion date.

demands_of_state.title: Publish road / PMGSY status for the access mile
demands_of_state.why: Incomplete road is a tax on every scheme, school day, and medical trip.

demands_of_state.title: Publish MGNREGA job-card coverage and person-days this FY
demands_of_state.why: Without local wages, out-migration is forced. Opacity hides whether work was created or only claimed.

demands_of_state.title: Publish pension & widow beneficiary list (Gram Sabha board)
demands_of_state.why: Elders stay when youth leave. Money must reach passbooks, not middlemen.

demands_of_state.title: Publish PM-KISAN and PMAY-G beneficiary status for this GP
demands_of_state.why: Eligibility without a public list is where corruption lives.

demands_of_state.title: Upload Gram Sabha minutes and works photos with dates
demands_of_state.why: Completed-on-paper, broken-on-ground is the classic leak. Photos + dates close it.
